---
title: "Before the day"
---
The day is worked mainly in the [browser lab](../../cases/housing/lab.qmd), a page of the course site on which R runs inside your browser, with the data already in place, so there is nothing that you have to install. Installing R, an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.) and the downloadable workspace is optional, but this is the format that uses them most: Part 2 has a stretch on the IDE and Part 4 one on the report, and with the workspace you work through both on your own machine rather than following them on the shared screen.

| Work through | What you do | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| [Case study](../../cases/housing/index.qmd) | The original study and its design, SCORE and the Multi100 project, the five reanalyses and the question that each of them answered, how their results were put on one scale, and the replication with new data. Every part of the day works on this case. | 45 minutes |
| [Browser lab](../../cases/housing/lab.qmd) | Open it once on the machine and the browser that you will use, wait until the first cell shows a "Run Code" button, and run the setup cell of Task 1. If it does not load, try another browser, and tell the facilitator before the day. | 10 minutes |
| [Setup](../../setup.qmd) | Optional, and recommended for this day. Install R and an IDE, download the workspace zip and run `R/check_setup.R` until it prints OK. The [help page](../../help.qmd) has the problems that other participants have met. | 30 to 60 minutes, once |
| [Positron, RStudio and VS Code](../../companion/ide.qmd) | Optional. Where the console, the variables and the data viewer are in the IDE that you chose, and what changes between the three. | 30 minutes |

**By the start of the day** you have the browser lab loading on the machine that you will use, or the workspace working if you installed it, and you know what the claim is and who the five Multi100 analysts were.
